text:
maya (PM): Quick kickoff for the 'degrade-safe routing' initiative. Need cross-team sequencing, launch gates, and rollback triggers documented before sprint starts. Can we do a short sync tomorrow?

sam (Eng): I can make it. Clarify: are we doing per-tenant variant swaps or family-level routing when a model is unavailable?

jordan (Runtime): Recommendation: family-level routing for alpha (lower blast radius). Per-tenant variant mapping is a later opt-in. We can implement family routing + a cached-prefix degrade within 1 week. Full per-tenant variant weights ~2w.

leila (Infra): Family routing needs a reserved prewarm pool and autoscale guardrails to avoid cold starts. Need traffic burst profile and per-tenant caps to size pools.

maya (PM): Draft goals: keep p95 latency within SLA on degradations, keep fidelity within an agreed delta, and enable safe canary + rollback. Initial burst estimate: 2x baseline for first 24h. Pilot per-tenant cap: 100 req/s.

ethan (Security): Important: quantized/alternate models might not be allowed for regulated tenants. Need an allowlist and audit events for each fallback decision (tenant, reason, model-id). KMS for any cached data.

alex (SRE): We'll add metrics and alerts: fallback_rate{tenant, route, variant} and a paged alert if fallback_rate > 5% for 5m. Also want a runbook for disabling fallbacks globally and per-tenant.

sam (Eng): Runtime can emit fallback events now; adding model_id + reason requires a small proto change. I'll land a backward-compatible change in ~3d.

jordan (Runtime): Minimal plan: A) exact-variant route if available, B) family-compatible alternate in same region, C) cached-prefix degrade. A+B for alpha in 1w. C needs cache index and TTL work from infra.

leila (Infra): Proposed prewarm config (staging):
```
prewarm_pool:
  type: reserved
  gpu_count: 4
  reserved_for: degrade-safe-pilot
  autoscale:
    min: 2
    max: 12
    metric: requests_per_sec
    threshold: 200
```

maya (PM): Acceptance criteria proposal:
- Canary: 5% traffic for 48h, fallback_rate < 2%
- Quality: eval prompt set pass, avg delta < 3% by our metrics
- Security: allowed-variant doc & audit coverage
- Infra: prewarm + rollback knobs in console

ethan (Security): For regulated tenants default is NO fallback to quantized models unless explicitly opted-in. I'll produce a short policy doc by EOD Friday.

alex (SRE): I'll add dashboard tiles and the fallback_rate metric. I'll also draft the runbook and include automated rollback steps.

sam (Eng): Rollout steps: feature flag, proto change, runtime alpha, infra pool, canary. Timebox: proto & unit tests (3d), runtime alpha (4d), infra staging (2d), canary (2d).

maya (PM): Action items:
- sam: RFC + PR for proto change (24h)
- jordan: alpha routing + integration tests (1w)
- leila: create prewarm pool + autoscale template in staging (3d)
- ethan: policy doc for regulated tenants (EOD Fri)
- alex: dashboard + runbook (3d)
- maya: write canary checklist and acceptance criteria, schedule 20m sync tomorrow 10:30am PT

deploy-bot: reminder set: "degrade-safe routing sync" tomorrow 10:30am PT in #product — please RSVP

maya (PM): Rollback thresholds proposal: fallback_rate > 5% for 15m OR p95 latency > SLA + 150ms for 15m => automatic rollback. OK?

jordan (Runtime): Fine. We'll expose a control API for infra/sre to flip fallback off.

sam (Eng): Adding tests to simulate model availability loss and verify rollback triggers.

leila (Infra): Will wire the control API into the autoscaler and add a kill-switch in console.

ethan (Security): Event schema for audits will include tenant_id, decision_reason, model_id, triggering_metric. Will share schema by EOD.

maya (PM): Thanks all. I'll record this thread as the sprint handoff doc and tag owners. If no objections, proceed with next steps. :rocket:
